description: This file implements a plugin for HDMI CEC (Consumer Electronics Control) management, including handling HDMI hotplug events, device address management, and remote control commands. It includes classes and methods for enabling/disabling CEC, processing CEC frames, and persisting settings.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2
classes.description: Main plugin class managing HDMI CEC functionalities, including event handling, settings, and device communication.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2FrameListener
classes.description: Listens for CEC frames and logs received data.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2Processor
classes.description: Processes various CEC messages and commands, manages device address states, and communicates with the connected device.

methods.name: setEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to enable or disable CEC based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: getEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get current CEC enabled status.

methods.name: setOTPEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to enable or disable OTP feature.

methods.name: getOTPEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get current OTP enabled status.

methods.name: setOSDNameWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set the On-Screen Display name.

methods.name: getOSDNameWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get the current OSD name.

methods.name: setVendorIdWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set the vendor ID.

methods.name: getVendorIdWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get the current vendor ID.

methods.name: performOTPActionWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to perform OTP action if enabled.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads CEC configuration settings from persistent storage.

methods.name: persistSettings
methods.description: Persists CEC enable/disable status.

methods.name: persistOTPSettings
methods.description: Persists OTP enable/disable status.

methods.name: persistOSDName
methods.description: Persists the OSD name setting.

methods.name: persistVendorId
methods.description: Persists the vendor ID setting.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables CEC functionality.

methods.name: setOTPEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables OTP feature.

methods.name: CECEnable
methods.description: Initializes and enables CEC communication.

methods.name: CECDisable
methods.description: Disables and cleans up CEC communication.

methods.name: getPhysicalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the physical address of the device.

methods.name: getLogicalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the logical address of the device.

methods.name: performOTPAction
methods.description: Performs OTP related actions, such as power cycling.
